column1: # Lamakan Desert: Mia is shaken by the Manticore, recognizes her anger, and asks the others to stay close.

column3:
When it attacked us,
I wanted to make it
suffer, not just stop it.{page_break}Even after it fell,
I was still angry.
That frightened me.{end_wait}
You went quiet\nwhen the fight ended.\nI thought you were hurt.{page_break}You wouldn't answer me.{end_wait}
I wasn't hurt, Garet.\nI was afraid of\nwhat I wanted to do.{end_wait}
Please give me a moment.\nMy hands are\nstill shaking.{end_wait}
Take the time you need.\nWe'll stay with you.{end_wait}
